old_problem: Link disable can remove the endpoint and affect siblings or the host. A final healthy link cannot prove the intended hierarchy alone disappeared and returned correctly in every one of 10,000 cycles.
disposition_reason: The source fully defines the operation class, exact count and recovery-state oracle. Exact vendor primitive, hierarchy, expected absence, timing/error limits, durable ledger and recovery can be approved Project Configuration. This resolves review semantics while keeping the high-risk execution gate closed.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2117, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2118 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00039-V002 / 2446b40f11481488 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
The row requires exactly 10,000 link disable/enable transactions; retrain-only actions or a final-state snapshot cannot replace disappearance and return coverage.
Bind one approved root-port/bridge/retimer/endpoint/GPU hierarchy and enumerate sibling blast radius before the vendor LTSSM/NVQual control primitive is enabled.

Treat each cycle as atomic: disable acknowledgement, expected endpoint absence only within scope, enable request, LTSSM/re-enumeration, required width/speed by deadline, and fresh error/health deltas.
Commit cycle N durably before N+1; setup, partial cycles, retries and tool restarts are not successful counts. Lossless compression must remain gap-detecting.
Stop on unexpected scope, failed disable/enable, missing/late/downtrained endpoint, sibling/host impact, new disqualifying AER/reset, evidence gap or thermal/power anomaly.
Preserve first-fault artifacts and never force re-enable or automatically retry; use only signed out-of-band recovery.
No link control, LTSSM/NVQual, PCIe query, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.purpose: Prove exactly 10,000 deliberate disable/enable transactions on the mapped link, with every intended endpoint disappearance followed by correct full-width/speed return and no disqualifying errors.
required_package: Pinned approved NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual link-control build, primitive and configuration
Immutable root-port/bridge/retimer/endpoint/GPU and sibling topology/blast-radius map
Approved disable acknowledgement, absence, enable, re-enumeration, width/speed and deadline rules
10,000-entry durable ledger/checkpoint, error-delta and first-fault interlock policy
Dedicated idle SUT, console, stable power/cooling and tested recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Preserve topology/link/error/health baselines; after point approval execute only the pinned link disable/enable primitive for entries 1..10000. For every entry durably record scoped disable, expected absence, enable, LTSSM/re-enumeration, settled width/speed, enumeration, errors and health before enabling the next cycle. Stop on first anomaly or evidence gap; do not force or retry.
test_case.expected_result: All 10,000 chronological entries prove only the approved link was disabled, the endpoint returned within deadline at required width/speed, siblings and host stayed within policy, no disqualifying new PCIe/GPU/host/BMC/thermal/power error occurred, and final topology/health is approved.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until primitive, hierarchy, absence/return contract, limits, ledger and recovery are approved. PASS requires 10,000 complete accepted transactions. FAIL on wrong scope, failed disable/enable, missing/late/downtrained endpoint, sibling/host disruption, disqualifying error/reset or failed recovery. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED; retries do not count.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact control scope, blast radius, acceptance, ledger/interlock and recovery are signed.
Use an isolated idle SUT with out-of-band console, stable power/cooling and explicit 10,000-cycle authorization.
Commit complete transaction evidence before permitting the next cycle.
Stop without forced recovery or retry on the first link/device/platform/evidence anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, tool/configuration and point authorization
Gap-detecting monotonic ledger 1..10000 with raw transaction state and timestamps
Per-cycle or lossless checkpoint correlation plus tool-restart and artifact-integrity audit
First-fault/recovery or clean final endpoint/link/host state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: At the first wrong scope, failed disable/enable, missing/late/downtrained endpoint, sibling/host effect, disqualifying error/reset or artifact gap, inhibit all later cycles and preserve the event. Do not force re-enable or replay; follow the signed out-of-band recovery and quarantine if topology/health is not restored.
